bites.title: OpenAI buys a travel startup
bites.en: OpenAI has bought Odessia, a travel startup. It was created by Francis Davidson, the founder of Sonder. OpenAI has not said what it plans to do in travel.
bites.ko: OpenAI가 소너 창업자가 만든 여행 스타트업 오데시아를 인수했어요.

bites.title: CoreWeave asks customers to pay early
bites.en: CoreWeave now asks more customers to pay up front. It also borrows against specific contracts and looks at short-term deals. The company said this in its third-quarter earnings.
bites.ko: 코어위브가 AI 사업 자금을 위해 고객 선결제와 짧은 계약을 늘리고 있어요.

bites.title: Millions strike in Spain over housing costs
bites.en: Millions of people in Spain joined a 24-hour general strike. It was the first one in 14 years. They were protesting against rising housing costs.
bites.ko: 스페인에서 수백만 명이 집값 상승에 항의해 14년 만의 총파업에 나섰어요.

bites.title: Empty offices become new flats
bites.en: Many office buildings have low occupancy rates. Some of them are now being changed into flats for people to live in.
bites.ko: 빈 사무실 건물이 사람이 사는 아파트로 바뀌고 있어요.

bites.title: Burberry returns to profit
bites.en: Burberry is making a profit again after a back-to-basics plan. Its coats, jackets and handbags sold well. The CEO says a democratic approach helped the brand.
bites.ko: 버버리가 기본으로 돌아간 전략으로 다시 흑자를 냈어요.

bites.title: Korean firms invest in rare-earth magnets
bites.en: The US will make stricter rules on Chinese materials in defense equipment next year. Because of this, South Korean firms are investing more in rare-earth magnets.
bites.ko: 미국의 방위 장비 규제에 맞춰 한국 기업들이 희토류 자석 투자를 늘리고 있어요.

bites.title: New York starts enforcing its AI safety law
bites.en: New York is ready to enforce a big AI safety law. Large developers such as OpenAI and Anthropic must register and share their safety practices. They must also report serious incidents or pay fines.
bites.ko: 뉴욕 AI 안전법이 시행돼 OpenAI와 앤트로픽은 안전 관리와 사고를 보고해야 해요.

bites.title: OpenAI quarterly sales pass $10 billion
bites.en: OpenAI's sales reportedly passed $10 billion in one quarter for the first time. That is almost 50% more than the $6.7 billion it made in the second quarter.
bites.ko: OpenAI의 분기 매출이 처음으로 100억 달러를 넘었다고 해요.

bites.title: British chip startup Fractile raises $720M
bites.en: Fractile, a British company, has raised $720 million. It is now one of the best-funded makers of chips built for AI.
bites.ko: 영국의 Fractile이 7억 2천만 달러를 모아 AI 전용 반도체 경쟁에 뛰어들었어요.

bites.title: Ring's home drone has no manual controls
bites.en: Ring's camera drone will fly only with an AI pilot. Users cannot control it by hand. It follows set routes and avoids obstacles by itself.
bites.ko: 링의 집 안 카메라 드론은 수동 조종 없이 AI 조종사만으로 날아요.

bites.title: How GTA VI's world was built
bites.en: Rockstar North developers say years of research went into the new game's world. In 2015, they took their first trips to Miami to study the place.
bites.ko: GTA 6의 가상 플로리다는 개발자들이 2015년부터 현지를 답사하며 만들었어요.

bites.title: Police watchdog warns about facial recognition errors
bites.en: Inspectors found that some officers acted on possible matches without enough checks. This could lead to wrongful arrests, especially of ethnic minorities.
bites.ko: 경찰이 얼굴 인식 결과를 충분히 확인하지 않아 소수 인종이 억울하게 체포될 수 있다는 경고가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Home Assistant launches a smart home multi-tool
bites.en: Nabu Casa has launched a new box called Connect Aux-2. It helps people bring devices that are not smart into their smart home.
bites.ko: 홈어시스턴트가 일반 가전을 스마트홈에 연결해 주는 새 기기를 내놨어요.

bites.title: Databricks AI agent gives the CEO honest answers
bites.en: Databricks has 12,000 employees, so its CEO cannot know everyone. He uses its updated Genie agent to learn what is going wrong in the company.
bites.ko: 데이터브릭스 CEO는 새 AI 에이전트 Genie로 회사의 문제를 솔직하게 듣고 있어요.

bites.title: Google tests an AI tool called Tabletop
bites.en: Google has made an experimental AI tool named Tabletop. It builds custom spaces where family and friends can work together.
bites.ko: 구글이 가족·친구와 협업하는 맞춤 공간을 만드는 실험용 AI 도구 Tabletop을 선보였어요.

bites.title: Toyota brings back the Scion name
bites.en: Toyota is reviving the Scion name for a new project. Its first vehicle is a small kei truck made in America. The brand will test new ideas for mobility.
bites.ko: 도요타가 사이언 브랜드를 되살려 미국산 소형 경트럭을 첫 모델로 내놓아요.

bites.title: MIT designs tougher nature-inspired metamaterials
bites.en: MIT engineers used networks found in nature to design stronger materials. These could absorb impact better in helmets, packaging and armor.
bites.ko: MIT 연구진이 자연의 그물 구조에서 배워 충격을 더 잘 흡수하는 메타물질을 설계했어요.

bites.title: AI data centres plan huge gas power stations
bites.en: A report says AI data centre developers plan 181GW of gas power capacity in the US and Europe. They want their own power because connecting to the grid is slow.
bites.ko: AI 데이터센터가 전력망 연결이 늦어 미국·유럽에 181GW 규모 가스발전소를 자체로 지으려 해요.

bites.title: Euclid maps more than 900 million galaxies
bites.en: Europe's Euclid mission has released its first major data. It shows over 900 million galaxies. Scientists hope it will help explain the dark universe.
bites.ko: 유럽 유클리드 탐사선이 9억 개가 넘는 은하를 담은 첫 대규모 자료를 공개했어요.

bites.title: Parker Solar Probe finds a pattern in the Sun's chaos
bites.en: NASA's Parker Solar Probe found something new. At very small scales, turbulent magnetic fields reverse the direction they rotate.
bites.ko: 파커 탐사선이 아주 작은 규모에서 난류 자기장의 회전 방향이 뒤바뀐다는 걸 발견했어요.

bites.title: Superconducting vortices show clogging is a phase transition
bites.en: Clogging is when moving particles get stuck and block a flow. Researchers at Science Tokyo used superconducting vortices to show it is a true phase transition.
bites.ko: 도쿄과학대 연구진이 초전도 소용돌이로 '막힘' 현상이 상전이임을 실험으로 보였어요.

bites.title: Earth's water may have formed in its fiery birth
bites.en: Scientists found that hot rocky pebbles reacting with hydrogen can make water in minutes. Earth's water may have formed this way, not come from comets.
bites.ko: 뜨거운 돌 알갱이와 수소가 반응해 몇 분 만에 물이 생길 수 있어 지구의 물이 이렇게 생겼을지 몰라요.

bites.title: A fungus that infects another fungus
bites.en: A study found that Ampelomyces, a fungus living inside cells, infects powdery mildew. It is much more common than scientists knew before.
bites.ko: 흰가루병균을 감염시키는 곰팡이 암펠로미세스가 생각보다 훨씬 흔하다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: Antarctic ozone hole is the seventh largest on record
bites.en: NASA says the 2026 ozone hole is the seventh largest ever. Unusual weather pushed it near its maximum. Limits on harmful chemicals stopped it from growing more.
bites.ko: 올해 남극 오존 구멍이 역대 7번째 크기가 됐지만 규제 덕에 더 커지진 않았어요.

bites.title: MIT builds faster AI models for climate prediction
bites.en: MIT scientists created a training method for models that simulate how human activity affects climate. These models run much faster than other methods.
bites.ko: MIT가 인간 활동이 기후에 미치는 영향을 훨씬 빠르게 모사하는 AI 모델 훈련법을 개발했어요.

bites.title: Climate change tripled the odds of Iberia's fire weather
bites.en: A wildfire report says the extreme fire weather in Spain and Portugal in 2025 was three times more likely because of human-caused climate change.
bites.ko: 2025년 이베리아반도의 극심한 산불 날씨는 기후변화로 발생 가능성이 3배 높아졌어요.

bites.title: Tropical seas were not always the most diverse
bites.en: Today, tropical waters have more kinds of sea animals than polar waters. A new study finds this was not always true in the past.
bites.ko: 열대 바다가 늘 가장 다양했던 건 아니라는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: A retired ocean liner will become a huge reef
bites.en: The SS United States was once a famous luxury liner. It is now set to become the largest artificial reef in the world.
bites.ko: 한때 유명했던 여객선 SS 유나이티드 스테이츠가 세계 최대 인공 어초가 돼요.

bites.title: A 66-pound rodent lived 34 million years ago
bites.en: Scientists found fossils of a giant rodent in Thailand. It was named Yakamys sirindhornae and may have weighed about 66 pounds.
bites.ko: 태국에서 3,400만 년 전 약 30kg짜리 거대 설치류 화석이 발견됐어요.

bites.title: An armored sea amphibian from 237 million years ago
bites.en: Fossils found in China show a giant-salamander-sized amphibian with armor. It may be the first known amphibian that adapted to salt water.
bites.ko: 중국에서 2억 3,700만 년 전 바다에 적응한 갑옷 입은 양서류 화석이 발견됐어요.

bites.title: Mosquitoes like different people for different reasons
bites.en: A study found each mosquito species is drawn to its own mix of skin odors, chemicals and bacteria. So there may be no single mosquito magnet.
bites.ko: 모기 종마다 끌리는 피부 냄새·세균 조합이 달라서 '모기 자석'은 하나가 아닐 수 있어요.

bites.title: A wrist device helps a boy with Tourette syndrome
bites.en: Researchers in Nottingham built a wrist device for people with Tourette syndrome. A boy tried it and called the moment life-changing. It is meant to help stop his tics.
bites.ko: 노팅엄 연구진이 만든 손목 기기가 투렛증후군 틱을 줄이는 데 도움이 된다고 해요.

bites.title: Doctors say there is a better way than BMI to spot obesity
bites.en: Doctors say BMI alone can lead to wrong obesity diagnoses for millions of people. They suggest adding other measurements and tests. This could give patients better care.
bites.ko: BMI만으로는 비만을 잘못 진단할 수 있어서, 다른 측정과 검사를 함께 쓰자는 의사들의 주장이 나왔어요.

bites.title: One antidepressant may stop depression from coming back best
bites.en: An analysis of many patients compared antidepressants. A drug called escitalopram worked best at preventing relapse. It did better than Prozac.
bites.ko: 여러 환자를 분석했더니 항우울제 에스시탈로프람이 우울증 재발을 막는 데 가장 효과적이었어요.

bites.title: A new clue about why early Alzheimer's starts
bites.en: A report in Nature points to the blood-brain barrier. It says this barrier blocks proteins that could protect the brain. This may be a new cause of early Alzheimer's disease.
bites.ko: 혈뇌장벽이 뇌를 지켜 줄 단백질을 막는 것이 알츠하이머 초기의 새 원인일 수 있다는 소식이에요.

bites.title: Energy drinks are tied to many more heart problem reports
bites.en: A new study looked at reports of heart problems. Energy drinks and stimulant supplements had 11 times more reports of cardiac arrest. They also had 4.5 times more reports of heart attacks.
bites.ko: 에너지 음료와 각성 보충제는 심정지 보고가 11배, 심근경색 보고가 4.5배 많았다는 연구예요.

bites.title: Two forever chemicals tied to more aggressive breast cancer
bites.en: An NIH study checked women's blood for two common forever chemicals. Women with high levels had up to 93% higher rates of an aggressive breast cancer. This raises worries about everyday products.
bites.ko: NIH 연구에서 영원한 화학물질 두 가지 수치가 높은 여성은 공격적인 유방암 비율이 최대 93% 높았어요.

bites.title: Ukraine says its military internet was cut as US envoys met Putin
bites.en: Ukraine's president said military connectivity was disrupted by new speed limits. He said this helps the Russians kill. The news came as US envoys met Putin in Moscow.
bites.ko: 미국 특사들이 푸틴을 만나는 사이 우크라이나 군의 통신 속도가 제한됐다고 젤렌스키 대통령이 밝혔어요.

bites.title: Two men are found guilty of spying for Iran in the UK
bites.en: Two men were convicted in the UK. They helped Iranian intelligence with a plan to target journalists who live in Britain. Their names are Mostafa Sepahvand and Farhad Javadi Manesh.
bites.ko: 영국에서 두 남성이 이란 정보기관을 돕고 영국 거주 기자들을 노린 혐의로 유죄 판결을 받았어요.

bites.title: A Korean American Democrat wins a US House seat
bites.en: Dan Koh won a seat in the US House of Representatives. His grandfather's home village on Jeju Island celebrated with banners. Relatives and residents put them up on Nov. 5.
bites.ko: 댄 고 당선인이 미 하원에 입성하자 할아버지의 고향인 제주 마을이 현수막을 걸고 축하했어요.

bites.title: US Democrats go to Cop31 to show America still cares about climate
bites.en: Democrats now control Congress. This gives them more power to challenge President Trump on the environment. They went to the Cop31 climate summit to show the US has not given up.
bites.ko: 민주당이 의회를 장악해 트럼프의 환경 정책에 맞설 힘이 커졌고, 기후 회의에 가서 미국이 포기하지 않았다고 알렸어요.

bites.title: The EU proposes new rules against loot boxes and addictive apps
bites.en: The EU Commission published a new Digital Fairness Act. It aims to make online life fairer. Games, social media and online shops could face new rules.
bites.ko: EU 집행위가 디지털 공정성 법안을 내놓아 게임, SNS, 온라인 쇼핑 업체에 새 규칙이 생길 수 있어요.

bites.title: Leaders at Cop31 warn the world we know is over without action
bites.en: The Marshall Islands president said failing to act would end the world we know. He spoke about worsening floods. The UN chief asked for a windfall tax on oil and gas firms.
bites.ko: 마셜제도 대통령은 행동하지 않으면 지금의 세계가 끝난다고 경고했고, UN 사무총장은 석유·가스 기업 횡재세를 요구했어요.

gloss.meaning: 횡재세, 뜻밖의 큰 이익에 매기는 세금

bites.title: A judge lets Trump's $10 billion case against the BBC go on
bites.en: A federal judge ruled that Trump's defamation lawsuit against the BBC can continue. The judge turned down part of the BBC's request to dismiss it. The case is about how a program was edited.
bites.ko: 미 연방판사가 트럼프의 BBC 상대 100억 달러 명예훼손 소송을 계속 진행하도록 허용했어요.

bites.title: Rescuers search a collapsed building in Brooklyn
bites.en: A building collapsed in Brooklyn, New York. Two people died and several were hurt. Rescuers pulled one survivor from the rubble.
bites.ko: 뉴욕 브루클린에서 건물이 무너져 2명이 숨지고 여럿이 다쳤으며, 구조대가 잔해에서 생존자를 구했어요.

bites.title: Indonesian fires have burned 2.9 million hectares this year
bites.en: A monitor using satellite images says fires in Indonesia burned 2.88 million hectares in 2026. A strong El Nino helped cause them.
bites.ko: 위성 영상을 분석한 기관에 따르면 올해 인도네시아 산불이 약 288만 헥타르를 태웠고, 강한 엘니뇨도 한 원인이에요.

bites.title: Skulls of two enslaved people go home to Brazil from Harvard
bites.en: Two skulls were returned to Brazil. They probably belonged to Africans or Afro-Brazilians. Harvard had used them in eugenics studies.
bites.ko: 하버드가 우생학 연구에 썼던 노예 출신으로 보이는 두 사람의 두개골이 브라질로 돌아갔어요.

bites.title: A historian says humility gained social weight in the late Middle Ages
bites.en: People often picture medieval monks who punished themselves to show humility. A historian argues that humility also took on a social meaning at that time. It was one of the basic virtues.
bites.ko: 중세 후기에 겸손이 단순한 신앙 덕목을 넘어 사회적 의미를 갖게 됐다고 한 역사학자가 주장해요.

bites.title: A study finds scientists disagree on what science is
bites.en: A study in Royal Society Open Science asked scientists about science itself. It found that they hold surprisingly different ideas. They disagree about its meaning.
bites.ko: 과학자들도 과학이 무엇인지에 대해 생각이 서로 꽤 다르다는 연구가 나왔어요.

bites.title: An Indian mega library faces a scandal over AI-generated books
bites.en: Tamil Nadu has a new large library in India. A scandal says some books may be made by AI. The state government ordered an internal audit of library collections.
bites.ko: 인도 타밀나두의 대형 도서관에 AI가 쓴 책 논란이 일어 주 정부가 장서 내부 감사를 명령했어요.

bites.title: UK councils own over 500,000 artworks, but most are in storage
bites.en: The BBC found that 225 councils own more than 500,000 pieces of art. Most of it is kept in storage. Only some is on display.
bites.ko: 영국 225개 지방의회가 50만 점 넘는 미술품을 갖고 있지만 대부분 창고에 있다고 BBC가 밝혔어요.

bites.title: Pianist Lim Yunchan and composer Lee Hanurij win big prizes
bites.en: Pianist Lim Yunchan won Apple Music's album of the year. His friend, the composer Lee Hanurij, aged 20, won first prize in composition at the 80th Geneva competition. Both wins came within hours.
bites.ko: 피아니스트 임윤찬이 애플 뮤직 올해의 앨범을, 친구 작곡가 이한울이 제네바 콩쿠르 작곡 1위를 같은 때에 차지했어요.

bites.title: A twisted 1834 coin may show a rare minting accident
bites.en: A bent British silver coin from 1834 was found at a car boot sale. 3D scans and microscope tests found odd metal changes. They suggest it was crushed during a rare minting accident.
bites.ko: 1834년 영국 은화가 심하게 찌그러진 이유가 희귀한 주조 사고 때문일 수 있다는 분석이 나왔어요.

bites.title: Old manuscripts hold DNA of a sheep virus
bites.en: Scientists found traces of a sheep virus in 1,000-year-old manuscripts, including the York Gospels. The virus has changed very little over thousands of years. Its history goes back more than 3,700 years.
bites.ko: 1000년 된 요크 복음서 등 옛 필사본에서 양 바이러스 DNA가 발견돼, 3700년 넘는 역사가 드러났어요.

bites.title: Nicole Kidman to get an honorary Cesar
bites.en: Nicole Kidman will receive an honorary Cesar from the French film academy. The prize will be given at the 52nd Cesar Awards on Feb. 25, 2027, at the Olympia in Paris.
bites.ko: 니콜 키드먼이 2027년 2월 25일 파리 세자르 영화제에서 명예 세자르상을 받아요.

bites.title: Tom Holland says 'The Odyssey' changed his goals
bites.en: Tom Holland starred in two of this year's biggest films, Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey. He says the Christopher Nolan epic will shape the next stage of his career.
bites.ko: 톰 홀랜드가 올해 대흥행작 두 편 중 놀런 감독의 「오디세이」가 앞으로의 경력에 영향을 줄 거라고 말했어요.

bites.title: Spotify picks rookie group Lngshot
bites.en: Spotify has chosen the new boy group Lngshot for its Radar Korea program. The program supports new musicians. The group has four members.
bites.ko: 스포티파이가 신인 4인조 보이그룹 렁샷을 신인 지원 프로그램 '레이더 코리아' 아티스트로 뽑았어요.

bites.title: Dua Lipa to headline Coachella 2027
bites.en: Dua Lipa will be the first British woman to headline Coachella. Tame Impala and SZA will also be at the top of the 2027 bill. Madonna and Diljit Dosanjh are on the line-up too.
bites.ko: 두아 리파가 영국 여성 가수 최초로 2027 코첼라 헤드라이너가 돼요. 테임 임팔라와 SZA도 함께해요.

bites.title: X launches its own clipping tool
bites.en: X has launched a clipping feature. Clipping means cutting long videos into short clips that can go viral. The company hopes it will boost engagement from influencers.
bites.ko: X가 긴 영상을 짧게 잘라 퍼뜨리는 '클리핑' 기능을 내놨어요. 인플루언서 참여를 늘리려는 거예요.

bites.title: Wayne Rooney joins I'm A Celebrity
bites.en: Football star Wayne Rooney leads this year's I'm A Celebrity line-up. Gavin and Stacey actor Joanna Page and the YouTuber Sharky will join him.
bites.ko: 축구 스타 웨인 루니가 올해 「I'm A Celebrity」 출연진의 선두에 섰어요. 조애나 페이지와 유튜버 샤키도 나와요.

bites.title: King Charles joins Elton John's radio show
bites.en: King Charles appears on Elton John's radio show, Rocket Hour. The episode was recorded in secret. It will air on the king's 78th birthday on Saturday.
bites.ko: 찰스 3세가 엘턴 존의 라디오 쇼에 깜짝 출연해요. 78번째 생일인 토요일에 방송돼요.

bites.title: Harry Kane to break England caps record
bites.en: Harry Kane will play his 126th match for England against Croatia at Wembley. He will become the most capped player in the men's national team.
bites.ko: 해리 케인이 크로아티아전에서 126번째 A매치를 뛰며 잉글랜드 남자 대표팀 최다 출전 선수가 돼요.

bites.title: USA pulls out of the U-17 World Cup
bites.en: The USA has withdrawn from the Under-17 World Cup in Qatar. The tournament starts next week. The team cited the risk of armed conflict.
bites.ko: 미국이 다음 주 카타르에서 시작하는 U-17 월드컵에서 무력 충돌 위험을 이유로 빠지기로 했어요.

bites.title: Korean women to face North Korea in Olympic qualifiers
bites.en: South Korea's women's team will play North Korea in the last Asian group round for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. The draw was held by the Asian Football Confederation. A trip to Pyongyang is possible in December next year.
bites.ko: 한국 여자 축구대표팀이 2028 LA 올림픽 아시아 예선에서 북한과 만나요. 내년 12월 평양 원정 가능성이 있어요.

bites.title: Two unanimous Cy Young winners
bites.en: Cam Schlittler of the Yankees and Jacob Misiorowski of the Brewers won the Cy Young Awards. Both votes were unanimous. The award goes to the best pitcher in each league.
bites.ko: 양키스 슐리틀러와 브루어스 미시오롭스키가 만장일치로 사이영상을 받았어요.

bites.title: LG Twins re-sign Austin Dean
bites.en: The LG Twins have re-signed Austin Dean on a one-year, $2 million deal. He is now the highest-paid foreign position player in KBO history.
bites.ko: LG 트윈스가 오스틴 딘과 1년 200만 달러에 재계약했어요. KBO 외국인 야수 최고 연봉이에요.

bites.title: Stephen Curry hurts his abdomen
bites.en: Stephen Curry hurt his right abdomen in the first quarter against the Rockets. Coach Steve Kerr said the team's concern is high. Curry will have an MRI.
bites.ko: 스테픈 커리가 로키츠전 1쿼터에 오른쪽 복부를 다쳤어요. 커 감독은 우려가 크다고 했고 MRI 검사를 받아요.

bites.title: Zion Williamson wants more accountability
bites.en: The Pelicans lost their fourth game in a row. Zion Williamson said the team must look itself in the mirror. He called for more accountability.
bites.ko: 펠리컨스가 4연패에 빠지자 자이언 윌리엄슨이 선수들이 스스로를 돌아봐야 한다고 말했어요.

bites.title: Korea passes 20 million visitors
bites.en: Korea has welcomed more than 20 million foreign visitors this year, the culture ministry said. It is the first time the country has crossed that mark. It first reached 10 million 14 years ago.
bites.ko: 올해 한국 방문 외국인이 처음으로 2000만 명을 넘었다고 문체부가 밝혔어요. 1000만 명을 처음 넘은 지 14년 만이에요.

bites.title: Tasmania tells tourists to stay away
bites.en: Tasmania says it is not really for tourists. Some people think this is clever reverse psychology. The idea comes from research showing that tourists hate themselves.
bites.ko: 타즈메이니아가 '관광객용 섬이 아니다'라며 오지 말라고 해요. 일부는 역심리 마케팅이라고 봐요.

gloss.meaning: 일부러 반대로 말해 끌어당기는 심리 기법

bites.title: Mexican chef wins ramyeon contest
bites.en: A Mexican cook and content creator called Borrecito won a Korean ramyun contest. He had never planned to enter or visit Korea. His winning recipe used beer, chipotle and Shin Ramyun.
bites.ko: 멕시코 요리사 보레시토가 맥주와 치폴레를 넣은 신라면 레시피로 한국 라면 대회에서 1등을 했어요.

bites.title: Understanding therapy-speak
bites.en: Words from the therapist's chair now appear in daily talk, such as 'You're triggering me'. The BBC offers a guide for parents on what teenagers mean.
bites.ko: '넌 날 트리거해' 같은 상담실 말이 일상 대화에 퍼졌어요. BBC가 부모를 위한 해설을 냈어요.

bites.title: Early Black Friday deals start
bites.en: Black Friday is on November 27. Retailers have already started early discounts on tech products. Prices are rising in many places.
bites.ko: 블랙프라이데이는 11월 27일인데, 벌써 전자제품 조기 할인이 시작됐어요.

bites.title: US students rally for Starbucks workers
bites.en: Students are holding rallies at more than 40 US campuses on Thursday. They support Starbucks baristas who want better pay and conditions. The workers criticize stalled contract talks.
bites.ko: 미국 40여 개 대학 캠퍼스에서 학생들이 스타벅스 바리스타의 처우 개선 요구를 지지하는 집회를 열어요.

bites.title: Smith College reverses childcare closure
bites.en: Smith College quickly reversed its decision to close its childcare center. The backlash shows a growing concern about childcare on campus.
bites.ko: 스미스 칼리지가 캠퍼스 어린이집 폐쇄 결정을 반발에 곧바로 되돌렸어요. 캠퍼스 육아 시설 문제가 커지고 있어요.

bites.title: MIT football captain talks about balance
bites.en: Dominic Hess is an Academic All-American defensive back and co-captain of MIT's football team. He says football keeps him grounded and inspired.
bites.ko: MIT 풋볼 공동 주장 도미닉 헤스가 학업과 운동을 함께하며 풋볼이 마음을 단단하게 해 준다고 말해요.

bites.title: Retractions of old papers are rising
bites.en: Nature reports that retractions of old papers are on the rise. It asks when bad science should be culled from the literature.
bites.ko: 네이처가 오래된 논문의 철회가 늘고 있다며, 잘못된 연구를 언제 학계 기록에서 없애야 하는지 물어요.

bites.title: Women often miss author credit
bites.en: Nature asks whether women are named as authors or only acknowledged in research. It reports that women are not gaining full credit for their work.
bites.ko: 네이처가 연구에서 여성이 저자가 아닌 '감사의 글' 수준으로만 언급돼 충분한 공로를 못 받는다고 짚어요.

bites.title: AI makes coursework hard to grade
bites.en: England's Office for Students says AI has made it close to impossible to assess university coursework. It says universities should return to traditional exams and in-person presentations.
bites.ko: 영국 대학 규제기관이 AI 탓에 과제 평가가 거의 불가능하다며 전통 시험과 대면 발표로 돌아가라고 했어요.

bites.title: Pentagon ends Brown and Naval War College link
bites.en: The Department of Defense has ended a partnership between Brown University and the Naval War College, Inside Higher Ed reports.
bites.ko: 미국 국방부가 브라운대와 해군전쟁대학의 협력 관계를 끝냈다고 인사이드 하이어 에드가 전해요.

bites.title: MIT welcomes seven new computing faculty
bites.en: The MIT Schwarzman College of Computing welcomed seven new faculty members for 2026. They work in core computing and in shared roles with other fields.
bites.ko: MIT 슈워츠먼 컴퓨팅대학이 2026년 신임 교수 7명을 맞았어요. 핵심 컴퓨팅과 타 분야 겸임 역할을 맡아요.
